description: Permanently delete an automated task from an instance. This cannot be undone. If the user only wants the task to stop running for now, call update_task with enabled set to false instead.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set this only after showing the user exactly what will be deleted, naming the task and describing what it currently does and getting their approval.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

task_id.description: Id of the task to delete, as returned by list_tasks.

name: delete_task
title: Delete Automated Task
